ayahOccurrences.text: وَٱبْتَلُوا۟ ٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغُوا۟ ٱلنِّكَاحَ فَإِنْ آنَسْتُمْ مِّنْهُمْ رُشْدًا فَٱدْفَعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوهَآ إِسْرَافًا وَبِدَارًا أَن يَكْبَرُوا۟ ۚ وَمَن كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۚ فَإِذَا دَفَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ فَأَشْهِدُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ حَسِيبًا

ayahOccurrences.text: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ مَاذَآ أُحِلَّ لَهُمْ ۖ قُلْ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتُ ۙ وَمَا عَلَّمْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَوَارِحِ مُكَلِّبِينَ تُعَلِّمُونَهُنَّ مِمَّا عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّآ أَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَحَسِبُوٓا۟ أَلَّا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ فَعَمُوا۟ وَصَمُّوا۟ ثُمَّ تَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ عَمُوا۟ وَصَمُّوا۟ كَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَا تَطْرُدِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُۥ ۖ مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ وَمَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
حِسَاب ḥisāb [v. n.; n.]

1 reckoning, accounting, calculation, judgement

(14:41) رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ our Lord, forgive me, and my parents, and the believers on the Day when the Reckoning is held

2 reward, retribution

(23:117) وَمَنْ يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ لاَ بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ whoever prays to another deity alongside God–a deity for whose existence he has no evidence–his retribution will be with his Lord

3 [adjectivally/adverbially] sufficient, fitting, plenty/in accordance with

(78:35–6) جَزَاءً مِنْ رَبِّكَ عَطَاءً حِسَابًا a reward from your Lord, a fitting gift (or, in accordance with their deeds); *

(3:27) بِغَيْرِ حِسَاب with no limit, generously [lit. without counting]; *

(78:27) لاَ يَرْجُونَ حِسَاباً they do not believe in the Day of Judgment [lit. they do not fear any reckoning].

حَسِبَ ḥasiba 44 times; حَاسَبَ ḥāsaba 2 times; يُحَاسَبُ yuḥāsabu 1 time; يَحْتَسِبُ yaḥtasibu 3 times; حَسْبٌ ḥasb 11 times; حَاسِبِين ḥāsibın 2 times; حِسَابٌ ḥisāb 39 times; حَسِيبٌ ḥasıb 4 times and حُسْبَانٌ ḥusbān 3 times.

entries.label: حِسَاب
entries.definitionHtml:
حِسَاب ḥisāb [v. n.; n.]

1 reckoning, accounting, calculation, judgement

(14:41) رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ our Lord, forgive me, and my parents, and the believers on the Day when the Reckoning is held

2 reward, retribution

(23:117) وَمَنْ يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ لاَ بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ whoever prays to another deity alongside God–a deity for whose existence he has no evidence–his retribution will be with his Lord

3 [adjectivally/adverbially] sufficient, fitting, plenty/in accordance with

(78:35–6) جَزَاءً مِنْ رَبِّكَ عَطَاءً حِسَابًا a reward from your Lord, a fitting gift (or, in accordance with their deeds); *

(3:27) بِغَيْرِ حِسَاب with no limit, generously [lit. without counting]; *

(78:27) لاَ يَرْجُونَ حِسَاباً they do not believe in the Day of Judgment [lit. they do not fear any reckoning].

entries.label: حَاسَبَ
entries.definitionHtml:
حَاسَبَ ḥāsaba [v. III, trans.; pass. يُحَاسَبُ yuḥāsabu]

1 to call to account

(2:284) وَإِنْ تُبْدُوا مَا فِى أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ whether you reveal what you have in your heart or conceal it, God will call you to account for it

2 to take to task

(65:8) وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِ فَحَاسَبْنَاهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَاهَا عَذَابًا نُكْرًا many a town that insolently opposed the command of its Lord and His messengers–We have taken it to task and punished them severely.

entries.label: حَاسِب
entries.definitionHtml:
حَاسِب ḥāsib [act. part.] one who reckons, one who works out an account

(21:47) وَإِنْ كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا وَكَفَى بِنَا حَاسِبِينَ even if it be the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it out–and We are reckoners enough.

entries.label: حَسِب
entries.definitionHtml:
حَسِب ḥasiba a [v. trans.]

1 to fancy, to assume, to think, to presume

(23:55–6) أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ مَالٍ وَبَنِين نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى الْخَيْرَاتِ do they think by giving them wealth and sons, We hasten to give them good things?

2 [doubly trans.] to take something to be, to mistake for, to deem to be

(27:44) فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَنْ سَاقَيْهَا when she saw it, she took it to be a deep pool of water, and bared her legs.

entries.label: حَسِيبٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
حَسِيبٌ ḥasıb [intens. act. part.] a meticulous reckoner

(17:14) اقْرَأْ كِتَابَكَ كَفَى بِنَفْسِكَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيبًا read your record, today your own soul suffices as a meticulous reckoner of your deeds.

entries.label: حَسْب
entries.definitionHtml:
حَسْب ḥasb [v. n. used in construct (إِضَافَةٌ) as a quasi‐act. part.] sufficient, one who/which suffices

(8:64) يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَسْبُكَ اللَّهُ وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ Prophet, God is all sufficient for you, and for the believers who follow you; *

(3:173) حسبنا الله [interjection] we put our case before God alone, we appeal to God [lit. God is sufficient for us].

entries.label: حُسْبَانٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
حُسْبَانٌ ḥusbān I [v. n.] reckoning, calculating

(6:96) وَجَعَلَ اللَّيْلَ سَكَنًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ حُسْبَانًا ذَلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ He made the night for resting; and the sun and the moon for reckoning (or, to a precise calculation), that is the design of the Almighty, the All‐Knowing II [n.] projectile, thunderbolt, force of destruction

(18:40) وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيدًا زَلَقًا and sends on it a measured thunderbolt from the sky, so that it becomes slippery [barren] earth.

entries.label: يَحْتَسِبُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يَحْتَسِبُ yaḥtasib [imperf. of v. VIII احْتَسَبَ ʾiḥtasaba, trans.] to expect, to foresee, to surmise, to reckon with

(39:47) وَبَدَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَحْتَسِبُونَ and there will appear to them from God what they never reckoned with; *

(65:3) مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ يَحْتَسِبُ from a most unexpected source.
